summary: Global argcomplete needs bash 4.2: run activate-global-python-argcomplete --user, with --dest to change location or sudo for system-wide.
questions: How do I enable Ansible completion for all commands at once?
What bash version do I need for global argcomplete?

answer_card.title: Global argcomplete setup
answer_card.answer_md:
Requires bash 4.2.
```console
activate-global-python-argcomplete --user
```
Use `--dest` for another location, or `sudo` for system-wide.
